commands.ban: Bans a member, for good or for a while.
commands.kick: Removes a member. They can come back with an invite.
commands.timeout: Mutes a member for a while. They can read but not write.
commands.warn: Warns a member. Warnings add up on the escalation ladder.
commands.caseVoid: Marks a case as void. It stops counting towards escalation.
commands.cases: Lists recent cases, or the record of one member.
commands.reason: Sets or changes the reason of a case.
commands.warningsClear: Voids all active warnings of a member.
commands.warnings: Lists the active warnings of a member.
commands.lock: Stops members from writing in a channel. Moderators can still talk.
commands.slowmode: Sets how long members wait between messages in a channel.
commands.purge: Deletes recent messages in this channel, optionally filtered.
commands.massban: Bans several members at once by ID or mention.
commands.note: Adds a private note to a member file. Only moderators see notes.
commands.notes: Sends you the notes on a member as a DM.

done.ban: {hasDuration, select, yes {{who} is banned for {duration}. Case #{n}.} other {{who} was banned. Case #{n}.}}
